prompt: Create an original 150 second bossa nova instrumental composition for nature documentary, landscape and gentle exploration. Mood: organic, open, fresh. Instruments: nylon guitar, shaker, upright bass, electric piano. Style: syncopated guitar chords with gentle Latin groove. Tempo approximately 108 BPM; D dorian. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Introduce a gently rising motif and a sense of open air. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:50] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:50-01:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:40-02:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:30.

description.en: A calm and reflective instrumental piece that begins with a gentle acoustic guitar melody, gradually building with the introduction of piano, bass, light drums, and lush orchestral strings. The track evolves into a rich, emotional, and cinematic soundscape.
description.zh: 一首平静而富有沉思感的器乐作品，以柔和的木吉他旋律开场，随后逐渐加入钢琴、贝斯、轻柔的鼓点和华丽的管弦乐弦乐，最终发展成丰富、情感充沛且富有电影感的音景。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
